name: Generate cold outreach email and verify modal with pillars
description: Verify that clicking Generate Email opens the draft modal, successfully generates an outreach email without backend errors, displays the Corporate, Campus, and Community outreach pillars, and saves the draft.

planSteps.description: On the Kanban pipeline board, locate any card with a Generate Email or Draft button and click it to open the outreach email composer modal
Verify that the Email Draft modal opens with Subject line, Email body, and Pillar selector badges for Corporate, Campus, and Community Outreach
Click the Generate with Gemini or Save Draft button inside the modal
Verify that no error toast appears, the email draft is successfully populated, and the card is displayed in the Drafted stage
